name_zh: 格陵兰自治/因纽特领袖：极地自治治理与资源联邦制
name_en: Greenland Self-Governance/Inuit Leaders: Polar Autonomy Governance & Resource Federalism
description_zh: 格陵兰 1979 年获丹麦自治权，2009 年《自治法》扩大立法/司法/资源/外交权限，实质准主权实体。核心治理张力：因纽特文化自决 vs 丹麦王国纽带、资源开发 (稀土/铀/石油/氢能) vs 环境/气候脆弱性、人口 5.6 万支撑 216 万平方公里领土。体现 M179 极地自治治理——以"自治法框架+资源收益分享+因纽特语官方化+气候前沿适应"四支柱，在非完全独立状态下实现准主权治理。
description_en: Greenland gained Danish home rule 1979, 2009 Self-Government Act expanded legislative/judicial/resource/foreign affairs powers, de facto quasi-sovereign entity. Core governance tensions: Inuit cultural self-determination vs Danish kingdom ties, resource development (rare earths/uranium/oil/hydrogen) vs environmental/climate fragility, 56k population sustaining 2.16M km² territory. Exemplifies M179 Polar Autonomy Governance—four pillars of 'Self-Government Act framework + resource revenue sharing + Inuit language officialization + climate frontline adaptation' achieving quasi-sovereign governance without full independence.
reason_zh: 格陵兰是"非完全独立的准主权"独特范式：丹麦负责国防/外交/货币/公民权，格陵兰全权立法/司法/资源/教育/卫生/气候。M179 区隔于 M176 萨米协商(议会无立法权)、M177 因纽特(无国家框架)、M178 极地气候(工程)，核心在于"自治法法律框架+资源主权+因纽特民族建构"三位一体。
reason_en: Greenland unique 'quasi-sovereign without full independence': Denmark retains defense/foreign affairs/currency/citizenship, Greenland full legislative/judicial/resource/education/health/climate. M179 distinct from M176 Sami Consultation (parliament no legislative power), M177 Inuit (no state framework), M178 Polar Climate (engineering), core: 'Self-Government Act legal framework + resource sovereignty + Inuit nation-building' trinity.
steps_zh: 自治法法律框架：1979 自治/2009 自治法，分权清单(丹麦保留:国防/外交/货币/公民权；格陵兰全权:立法/司法/资源/教育/卫生/气候/原住民)
资源主权与收益分享：稀土(库亚纳克/莫雷内贝尔)/铀/石油/氢能，矿业法要求 FPIC/环评/收益分享/本地就业
因纽特民族建构：格陵兰语 (Kalaallisut) 唯一官方语言/教育/媒体/议会，民族认同重构
气候前沿适应治理：冰盖融化/海平面上升/永久冻土融沉/新航道/渔业迁移，主动适应规划/国际气候谈判主体性
外交半自主与北极理事会：格陵兰代表团独立参与北极理事会/北大西洋渔业/欧盟渔业协议/中美俄地缘博弈
steps_en: Self-Government Act legal framework: 1979 Home Rule/2009 Self-Government Act, division list (Denmark retains: defense/foreign affairs/currency/citizenship; Greenland full: legislation/judiciary/resource/education/health/climate/indigenous)
Resource sovereignty & revenue sharing: rare earths (Kvanefjeld/Moraine)/uranium/oil/hydrogen, Mineral Act requires FPIC/EIA/revenue sharing/local employment
Inuit nation-building: Greenlandic (Kalaallisut) sole official language/education/media/parliament, national identity reconstructed

Climate frontline adaptation governance: ice sheet melt/sea level rise/permafrost thaw/new shipping routes/fisheries migration, proactive adaptation planning/international climate negotiation subjectivity
Diplomatic semi-autonomy & Arctic Council: Greenland delegation independently participates Arctic Council/NAFO/EU fisheries/US-China-Russia Arctic geopolitics
expected_zh: 以"自治法框架+资源主权+因纽特语官方化+气候适应"四支柱，在非完全独立状态下实现准主权治理，为托管领土/自治区/原住民地区提供独特范式。
expected_en: Four pillars of 'Self-Government Act framework + resource sovereignty + Inuit language officialization + climate adaptation' achieve quasi-sovereign governance without full independence, providing unique paradigm for trust territories/autonomous regions/indigenous areas.
case_zh: 2009 自治法公投 75% 支持；库亚纳克稀土全球第二大储量；格陵兰语使用率 95%+；冰盖年融化 2800 亿吨；北极理事会永久参与者。
case_en: 2009 Self-Government Act referendum 75% support; Kvanefjeld rare earths world 2nd largest; Greenlandic usage 95%+; ice sheet annual melt 280Gt; Arctic Council permanent participant.
cross_cultural_impact: Autonomy model for indigenous regions; rare earth geopolitics; climate frontline governance; Arctic Council indigenous participation
diaspora_influence: Greenlandic diaspora in Denmark 17k+; international indigenous networks
indigenous_knowledge_system: Inuit ice/sea/weather knowledge; traditional hunting/fishing calendar; Qulliq oil lamp
resource_curse_mitigation: Mineral Act FPIC/EIA/revenue sharing; uranium mining ban (lifted 2013); sovereign wealth fund discussions
climate_adaptation: Ice sheet monitoring; sea level rise planning; permafrost infrastructure; fisheries migration management
